capabilities.purpose: Run the stable, self-updating topazlabscli executable and parse JSON results.

side_effects.external_mutation: May update the installed npm package and Agent Skill before a command; may upload videos and enqueue remote processing only when the user requests processing.
side_effects.authorization: Requires the user's configured SSH access and an explicit processing request.

side_effects.external_mutation: Writes only to the output path requested by the user.
